source.note: Kenney van (FBX like car-sedan, car-taxi and car-hatchback from the same kit, with Textures/colormap.png; the plan named the GLB member). A short-nose panel van (windowless cargo sides, flat high roof), scaled to real size: 2.3 m tall makes it 4.69 m long, matching a standard-body high-roof Toyota HiAce (about 4.70 m x 2.29 m). Kenney's toy proportions make it wider than the real van (2.56 m across the mirrors). Light-blue body from the indigo script's moon tone (#d5e2ff), a common delivery-van colour in Japan, distinct from the red sedan, white sports sedan, cream hatchback, yellow taxi and black/white police car; the source's amber lamps map to the practical/iris pair. Wheels are separate nodes in the source; static, no clips.
